title: Beethoven Virus (Full Version)
recommended: MASTER • 9★ • 707 notes • 13 SPACE • Song choreography v17.4.44

direction_profile.notes: All note directions were re-authored from a per-song movement grammar. FLAC-derived timing, note types, Reverse placement, SPACE timing, and note counts are unchanged.
direction_profile.readability_note: Retained note timestamps/directions are unchanged. Reverse flags are re-authored deterministically onto safer accents.

chart_design.principle: Lossless-source onset evidence selects subdivisions; phrase energy controls density; calm sections keep breathing room and payoff sections escalate.
chart_design.timing_rule: Verified BPM grid with FLAC-driven phase refinement; no free-running timestamp drift.
chart_design.difficulty_rule: NORMAL prioritizes first-read clarity; HARD maintains stable pressure; MASTER adds complexity and sustained pressure without long unreadable microburst walls.
chart_design.reverse_rule: Reverse is difficulty-scaled (~6% / ~12% / ~17%) and placed on locally readable accents whenever possible.
chart_design.readability_rule: Role-aware 0.5 s, 1 s, and 3 s budgets plus <100 ms and <170 ms chain guards. Retained timestamps/directions and all SPACE events are unchanged.
chart_design.benchmark_rule: Big Daddy v17.4.18 is the validated three-difficulty benchmark.
chart_design.direction_rule: Each song owns a deterministic movement grammar derived from its FLAC-timing rhythm fingerprint and section form. No global fixed direction motif bank or cyclic motif index is used.
chart_design.direction_guardrails: No same-direction spam, no immediate repeated 2–12-note blocks, no 4+ clockwise/counter-clockwise perimeter walks, and no three-step repeated translation vector.

library_standardization.policy: complexity plus sustained pressure; microbursts allowed but long unreadable chains are broken
